# Gabriel Gaetano Onen Baskara

> Software Developer based in Semarang, Indonesia, open to full-time roles, freelance projects and relocation.

Informatics graduate with freelance and internship experience. Built the backend of a production-tracking PWA used daily by 50-60 staff. Melodia (Spotify Clone) is a personal project in progress; its screenshots use demo catalog data and accounts.
